Google Places, batched
across the ingredient set

span.p:
Recipe + ingredients + stores
each labelled live or simulated

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
model_version is a fingerprint of the model name
AND the prompt text. Editing the prompt changes it,
so stale extractions are never served — and nothing
has to be manually purged.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The original threw all of this away every 15 minutes
and re-paid for a transcript fetch and an LLM call on
the next request. That was the dominant cost per
request and it was entirely avoidable.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Precision 5 rather than rounded lat/long: a rounding
boundary puts two people 100 m apart in different
cells, and a geohash cell degrades predictably.
